review_method: Visual comparison of all 13 deterministic GT/prediction panels; additionally inspected full-resolution rare-Others example. Curated coverage sample, not random error prevalence estimate.

samples.observations: Dense stopped traffic: many foreground vehicles match. Redundant overlapping boxes, distant errors and missed/confused partly visible vehicles remain. Dense overlap makes box extent important.

Near three-wheeler and truck are detected, but distant vehicles have extra boxes. A large false truck box spans the foreground camera/support structure: clear background false detection, not just a rare-class issue.
Many foreground and middle-distance two-wheelers are correctly detected. Tiny distant motorcycles overlap with redundant predictions; a few GT vehicles remain missed.
Most parked/foreground three-wheelers are detected. Extra boxes appear around distant vehicles and adjacent pedestrians/occluded regions. Large near vehicles work better than the crowded background.
Several large buses and trucks match. Leftmost partly obscured bus and distant right-side vehicles are missed; overlapping car/body predictions show localization/duplicate issues.

Two-wheelers and three-wheelers match. Bus/car regions receive conflicting overlapping predictions; the example does not establish reliable Mini-bus recognition despite its selection by Mini-bus support.
Some distant vehicles and two-wheelers match, while distant traffic has redundant boxes. The cropped vehicle at the left image boundary receives multiple overlapping class hypotheses.
Near motorcycles and three-wheelers match. Van/truck regions have overlapping class hypotheses and differing box extents; parked foreground truck is not cleanly localized in predictions.

Foreground three-wheeler and motorcycles match. Two annotated Others objects resembling handcarts are missed. The large covered foreground object is annotated Sedan but its visible appearance cannot confirm that identity; record taxonomy/visibility ambiguity separately, without changing GT.

Heavily overlapping queue: many vehicles match, but partly visible motorcycles/vehicles and distant rows show misses and duplicates. Visually confirmed occlusion; overlap-pair ranking was only a selection proxy.
Dense queue contains many correct large-vehicle detections but several red GT boxes on smaller or partly hidden vehicles. Redundant background boxes and class ambiguity among light vehicles remain.

FP-selected congested scene: many correct near detections coexist with numerous redundant boxes, distant detections and overlapping car/truck class hypotheses. Visually plausible unannotated distant objects may contribute to some unmatched predictions, but this was not independently adjudicated.
Sparse road: the single partially cropped edge vehicle is detected and the broad empty road has no extra detections at confidence .25.

annotation_limitations: Others is visually heterogeneous; covered/cropped vehicles can have ambiguous class identity.
Some unmatched distant boxes may reflect missing source annotations; this is a hypothesis, not a relabeling decision or corrected metric.
No annotation edits; all reported errors retain frozen GT. Occlusion has no explicit GT attribute.
